sentences: `s_cmov_b32` / `s_cmovk_i32`: D = SCC ? S0 : D (`s_cmovk_i32`'s S0 is the 16-bit immediate, sign-extended); SCC is read, not written; the destination must be an SGPR (a lane-mask destination stays `Unsupported`, #210).

`s_cmov_b64`: D[63:0] = SCC ? S0[63:0] : D[63:0] on plain 64-bit data pairs (SGPR pair, immediate or `null`), SCC read and not written; a pair that is or has been a lane mask stays `Unsupported` (#210).

D[63:0], SCC read and not written, on plain 64-bit data pairs (SGPR pair, immediate or `null`); any dword that is or has been a lane mask (EXEC, VCC or a mask SGPR) makes the pair `Unsupported` — conservatively, because a CFG join can drop a register that is a mask on only one path — while 0/-1 EITHER constants are data; selecting a per-lane bit as data would silently return a bool instead of the wave's mask (#210).
`s_pack_*`: the low half of D from S0, the high half from S1, the letters naming the half of each (l = 15:0, h = 31:16), S0 first; GFX10 has no `s_pack_hl`; SCC not written.

CPU-checked by `tests/semantic/test_salu_cmov.py` and `test_salu_pack.py`; the translated shaders were run on NVIDIA by reviewers (`s_cmov*`: RDNA2 ISA SOP1/SOP2/SOPK and LLVM AMDGPU [SOPInstructions.td](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/2bfedf3338162e2c841a73cd7cd9e98d00add608/llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/SOPInstructions.td) (`S_CMOV_B64 : SOP1_64` under `Uses = [SCC]`).

CPU-checked by `tests/semantic/test_salu_cmov.py`, `tests/semantic/test_salu_cmov_b64.py` and `test_salu_pack.py`; **not GPU-verified, no corpus count**; the translated shaders were run on NVIDIA by reviewers (`s_cmov_b32/k_i32`: **no corpus count**; GPU-checked for `s_cmov_b32` (`cs_w32_salu64.asm`, SCC = 1 selects S0) and `s_pack_lh_b32_b16` (`cs_w32_int_ext.asm`) on the Radeon iGPU of a Ryzen 9 9950X3D (RDNA2, `gfx1036`, driver 26.10.1) and an RTX 5080 (driver 616.92); `s_cmovk_i32`, `s_cmov_b64` and the other `s_pack_*` forms have no GPU test on main; the translated shaders were also run on NVIDIA by reviewers (`s_cmov_b32/k_i32`: RTX 5090, RTX 4050 and Radeon 740M in #613; `s_pack_*`: RTX 5090 in #449).
**Hardware-verified on RDNA2** (`gfx1035`, wave32 and wave64 via `tools/int_hw_probe.py --oracle both`, SHADER-137, SCC kept).

Also **measured on RDNA2 gfx1036** (Radeon iGPU of a Ryzen 9 9950X3D, Windows 11, driver 26.10.1, `tools/hw_oracle` HIP launcher, rocm-sdk-core clang): `tools/int_hw_probe.py --oracle both --wave both` gives the same words as the translator for all five `salu_cmov_pack` cases in wave32 and wave64, and the 14 `s_cmov_b64` cases of the `salu_cmov_b64` group (`python -I tools/int_hw_probe.py --oracle both --wave both --group salu_cmov_b64`; SCC 0 and 1; source an SGPR pair, the inline constants -1, -16 and 64, the literal 0x89abcdef, `null`, and the destination itself; SCC preset and read back after) match the translator in wave32 and wave64: SCC = 1 takes S0 (a literal zero-extended, an inline constant sign-extended, `null` gives 0), SCC = 0 keeps D, SCC is never written.

Measured on native gfx1036 (AMD Radeon Graphics, RDNA2) through tools/hw_oracle and tools/salu_diff.py: s_cmov_b32 verified under SCC=0 and SCC=1 (preserving destination and updating respectively); s_pack_ll/lh/hh_b32_b16 verified bit-exact on 500 random programs with 0 mismatches (--oracle translator,hw).
